exposure: Planned mode of delivery (prophylactic cesarean vs. trial of labor)
outcome: Neonatal outcomes (cord pH, cord lactates, Apgar scores, transfer to neonatal unit, deaths)
Maternal outcomes (uterine rupture, postpartum hemorrhage, deaths)
cohort: 410 patients with two previous cesarean sections
finding: Trial of labor after two previous cesarean sections appears to be a reasonable option in a selected population, with comparable neonatal outcomes and an acceptable risk of uterine rupture.
mod_finding: This study found that a trial of labor after two previous cesarean sections was successful in 67.3% of cases and resulted in comparable neonatal outcomes to planned cesarean section.
